messages:
alex: Heads-up — planning the cross-service cutover tonight 03:30 UTC. Need final confirmation on version pins + rollback signals for API / runtime / console / router. Deploybot will do a staged wave.

alex: Proposed pins: api@3.4.2, runtime@2.9.1-q, console@0.5.13, router@1.7.0. Canary 2% -> 20% -> 100%.

mia: ok, those pins look good to me. any special config on runtime quant flags?

alex: runtime will set quant_mode=fast-16 during canary, then revert to fast-8 after full roll if telemetry stable.

jordan: rollback criteria suggestion: error-rate >= 2% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency bump > 300ms for 5m OR any routing 5xx spike in router. Also watch KV cache evictions > 10k/min.

sre-oncall: agree with jordan. add disk pressure and OOM kill as immediate aborts. If any abort condition hit, traffic auto-steers to runtime@2.9.0 fallback and router pins to 1.6.x legacy.

devops: canary rollout plan: 2% for 10m (smoke + logs), step to 20% over 15m, then 100% after 30m observation. We'll keep autoscale headroom +30%.

jordan: add a short circuit rule in router: if route error-rate > 1.5% for 2m then route to fallback cluster. That prevents cascade to console.

alex: deploybot, schedule using the command below and attach the canary policy and abort hooks.

deploybot: Received. Will publish scheduled job and post updates into this thread.

alex: Copy of the deploy command we will use:
```
/deploy wave --canary 2 --step 20 --step-duration 900s --pins api@3.4.2 runtime@2.9.1-q console@0.5.13 router@1.7.0 --abort-hook "err>=2%:5m,p95>300:5m,kv_evictions>10000:5m,disk>90:1m"
```

lina: I'll own dashboards, alert thresholds, and will post live notes. I'll trigger manual abort if behavior looks noisy even if not tripping the automated hook.

mia: :thumbsup: I can freeze feature flags that touch console UI during the canary window.

devops: infra alarms set. I'll also pre-pop a runbook snippet in pager duty for oncall steps.

jordan: small nit — confirm that console migration includes schema compatibility check for routing headers. If not, hold and retest.

alex: good catch. console schema compatibility test passed in staging, but I'll re-run the header-pass smoke now.

deploybot: scheduled job created: start=1711069800, canary=2%, steps=[20,100], owner=@alex. Logs will stream to #eng-releases/deploy-logs.

sre-oncall: oncall confirmed and will monitor network/egress metrics. If we hit abort we will run this command: 
```
/deploy abort --signal router_fallback --reason "auto/manual abort"
```

lina: I'll post the runbook snippet and a short checklist 15m before start.

alex: final call — thumbs? If no objections we'll proceed as scheduled.

mia: +1

jordan: oncall ready, +1

devops: +1, infra green

alex: Thanks all — will post cadence updates and final release notes into this thread. Keep radio silence except for alerts during the window.

deploybot: update: preflight checks passed, artifact signatures verified. Will post canary start when triggered.
